ModMetaData.name: Jamel Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Mlie.StarWarsAnimalCollection's Jamel art (adult lifeStage look, south/east/north facings only - the dessicated-corpse texture stays on donor art) with an invented-recast render generated for this campaign. Donor ships this texture packed in an AssetBundle, not as a loose PNG - a loose PNG at the same texPath wins over the AssetBundle asset by load order (confirmed live 2026-09-11 for this same mod, Star Wars Animal Collection). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Jamel/Jamel_<facing>) the donor uses.
